changes.text: TacWAM Wet-Lab Tasks: glove-teleoperated lab-bench tasks on a UFACTORY xArm6 with a BrainCo Revo2 right hand wearing a Tujian EI-G012 tactile glove (880 taxels, 15 pads), static Orbbec RGB-D and RealSense D405 wrist cameras; 177 counted demonstrations in three folders plus uncounted sorting, whiteboard and dual-arm tube-pour folders; Hugging Face gate with manual approval, CC BY-NC 4.0, no paper.

VTAO-BiManip: masked visual-tactile-action pretraining on 216 human bimanual bottle-cap unscrewing trajectories (two 20-sensor touch gloves, HoloLens 2, mocap) guiding curriculum RL for dual Shadow Hands (63% seen, 51% unseen bottles in simulation) and run on dual LEAP hands with tactile sensors; no code statement.
TachinGlove: linked to TacWAM Wet-Lab Tasks, whose card names a Tujian EI-G012 glove (15 pads, 880 taxels) on the robot hand.

RSS Dual-Arm Tactile: the same account's tacwam-wetlab-tasks repository has dual-arm tube-pour folders dated 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-22, matching this release's two batches; noted as the probable source of the copied batch, files not opened.
